title: Crunchy Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A delicious twist on traditional tacos, featuring crispy chicken and crunchy toppings.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together salt, pepper, and a pinch of oil.
Dredge chicken pieces in the mixture, coating evenly.
Place chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
While chicken is baking, warm taco shells according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat diced tomatoes and salsa over low heat.
Once chicken is done, let it rest for a few minutes before shredding.
Assemble tacos by spooning shredded chicken onto a warmed shell, followed by a spoonful of the tomato/salsa mixture, and topped with cheese, cilantro, and a sprinkle of salt.
